title: Create src/tui/components/IterationHeader.tsx
description: Create the Ink component that renders the thick-bar iteration header shown at the start of each AI iteration. Displays iteration number, max, and task ID in a visually distinct format.
acceptanceCriteria: First and third lines are thick bars (▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓)
Middle line shows '↪ Iteration {n} of {max} · Task #{id}'
Iteration number and task ID are displayed in yellow

steps.details: Create the file. Import React, Box, Text from ink.

export function IterationHeader({ n, max, taskId }: { n: number; max: number; taskId: number }). Render: <Box flexDirection='column'><Text>{'▓'.repeat(30)}</Text><Text>↪ Iteration <Text color='yellow'>{n}</Text> of {max} · Task #<Text color='yellow'>{taskId}</Text></Text><Text>{'▓'.repeat(30)}</Text></Box>
Use process.stdout.columns to determine terminal width and fill the bar accordingly: `'▓'.repeat(Math.min(process.stdout.columns || 40, 60))`
